exposure: Vaginal natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery (vNOTES)
cohort: 125 patients under 43 years old who underwent fertility-preserving vNOTES over a 5-year period (2014-2019)
finding: This study found that vNOTES procedures did not appear to negatively affect the mode of delivery or cause pregnancy-related complications in women of reproductive age.
mod_finding: vNOTES did not affect the mode of delivery or cause an increase in extensive perineal tears during vaginal delivery.
